description: Tram On Road is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. A subsection of the road link geometry that indicates where there is a Tram within the road area. This is calculated from where the NGD Rail Network with definition of Tram intersects a road polygon and is calculated within a certain distance of these objects. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. The portal shows 2024-12-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
